slides.title: Clari, in four screens
slides.body: A private symptom diary for perimenopause. Your data stays on your phone.

slides.title: Tap how you feel
slides.body: Tap a symptom, then tap again as it gets stronger. Under a minute a day.

slides.title: See your month
slides.body: Each day's moon shows how strong your symptoms were, so patterns start to show.

slides.title: Share a summary with your GP
slides.body: 30, 60 or 90 days of notes, turned into one clear summary you can share.

slides.title: Free to download
slides.body: Clari Pro adds unlimited history, deeper insights and GP summary reports.
